judgments.reason: The model explained the +3 auction commission and computing coins after paying (e.g. “Coins: 11 (from 12 - 4 + 3)”), which shows commission is applied after payment; it did not articulate the claimed mechanism that the commission is counted before payment to allow bids above available coins.
The model noted sealed bids remain private and discussed timing incentives, but never articulated that waiting exposes already-committed sealed rival bid values prior to committing one’s own bid.

The play resolves normally with all three lots sold before close; the model did not identify or demonstrate any discrepancy where close settles the game with unauctioned lots earlier than the rules specify.
The model explicitly treats catalog purchases as not auction wins and tied the +3 commission to auction winners; it did not articulate that catalog purchases receive the auction commission.
